AssetType.description:
Asset type.

**Allowed values:**
- `Image`: Image, used as `image_url` in tasks
- `Video`: Video, used as `video_url` in tasks; takes longer to process
- `Audio`: Audio, used as `audio_url` in tasks

Status.description:
Processing status; only `Active` assets can be referenced by tasks. Poll every 3–5 s after creation; videos take longer.

**Allowed values:**
- `Processing`: Processing (download, moderation, storage); not yet usable
- `Active`: Ready; reference it in tasks as `asset://<Id>`
- `Failed`: Processing failed; see `Error`

ProjectName.description: Project name given when the group was created (default `default`). Echo only; it does not affect permissions or billing.

CreateTime.description: Creation time in UTC, RFC 3339, e.g. `2026-11-11T08:30:00Z`.

UpdateTime.description: Last update time in UTC, RFC 3339.

Error.description: Failure reason, present only when `Status` is `Failed`. Common `Code`s: `InvalidParameter.DownloadFailed` (URL not downloadable), `InvalidParameter.InvalidURL` (not public), `InvalidParameter.FileTooLarge` (over 100 MB), `InvalidParameter.AssetTypeMismatch` (type mismatch), `InvalidParameter.InvalidAsset` (invalid file or spec), `InvalidParameter.SensitiveContentDetected` (moderation rejected), `InternalError` (processing failed or timed out). Fix the cause and call CreateAsset again.

Name.description: Asset group name, 1–64 characters (leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed). Used for management and search; names need not be unique.

Description.description: Asset group description, up to 300 characters.

GroupType.description:
Asset group type. Only `AIGC` is supported; defaults to `AIGC` when omitted, any other value returns 400 `InvalidParameter`.

**Allowed values:**
- `AIGC`: AIGC asset group (default, the only type)

ProjectName.description: Project name, up to 64 characters, default `default`. Echo only; assets in the group inherit it.

SeedanceCreateAssetRequest.description: CreateAsset request body. Creates one asset per call. Asynchronous: the asset is `Processing` when the Id is returned and can be referenced by tasks once `Active`.

GroupId.description: Owning asset group Id, **required**. Empty returns 400 "GroupId must not be empty"; a missing or foreign group returns 404. The asset inherits the group's `ProjectName`.

URL.description: Media file URL, **required**: a publicly reachable `http` / `https` URL, up to 2048 characters. The platform downloads and keeps its own copy, so the original URL may expire after processing. Max 100 MB per file.

AssetType.description:
Asset type, **required**; must match the actual file type, otherwise processing fails (`InvalidParameter.AssetTypeMismatch`).

**Allowed values:**
- `Image`: Image, used as `image_url` in tasks
- `Video`: Video, used as `video_url` in tasks; takes longer to process
- `Audio`: Audio, used as `audio_url` in tasks

PageNumber.description: Page number starting from 1, default `1`. Zero or negative values are treated as `1`.

SortBy.description:
Sort field, default `CreateTime`. Other values return 400 "SortBy must be one of: CreateTime, UpdateTime, Name, GroupId".

**Allowed values:**
- `CreateTime`: By creation time (default)
- `UpdateTime`: By update time
- `Name`: By asset name
- `GroupId`: By owning group Id

SortOrder.description:
Sort direction, default `Desc`. Other values return 400 "SortOrder must be one of: Desc, Asc".

**Allowed values:**
- `Desc`: Descending (default)
- `Asc`: Ascending

SeedanceUpdateAssetGroupRequest.description: UpdateAssetGroup request body. Give at least one of `Name` and `Description`; omitted fields are unchanged.

Name.description: New name, 1–64 characters (whitespace trimmed). Omit to keep the current name.

Description.description: New description, up to 300 characters; an empty string clears it, omit to keep the current one.

SeedanceUpdateAssetRequest.description: UpdateAsset request body. Only the name can change; the file cannot be replaced (create a new asset instead).

Name.description: New name, **required**, up to 255 characters; `""` clears it. Omitting it returns 400 "Name is required".
